name: mementos
description: Encrypted AI memory vault for any AI tool. E2EE vectors, RAG retrieval, git sync.

scripts.test:docker:openclaw: docker build -f tests/docker/integration-test.Dockerfile --build-arg TOOL=openclaw --build-arg SMOKE=tests/docker/openclaw-smoke.ts -t mementos-openclaw-test . && docker run --rm mementos-openclaw-test
scripts.test:docker:claude-code: docker build -f tests/docker/integration-test.Dockerfile --build-arg TOOL=@anthropic-ai/claude-code --build-arg SMOKE=tests/docker/claude-code-smoke.ts -t mementos-claude-code-test . && docker run --rm mementos-claude-code-test
scripts.test:docker:claude-code-ingestor: docker build -f tests/docker/integration-test.Dockerfile --build-arg TOOL=@anthropic-ai/claude-code --build-arg SMOKE=tests/docker/claude-code-ingestor-smoke.ts -t mementos-cc-ingestor-test . && docker run --rm mementos-cc-ingestor-test
scripts.test:docker:codex: docker build -f tests/docker/integration-test.Dockerfile --build-arg TOOL=@openai/codex --build-arg SMOKE=tests/docker/codex-smoke.ts -t mementos-codex-test . && docker run --rm mementos-codex-test
scripts.test:docker:antigravity-cli: docker build -f tests/docker/antigravity-cli.Dockerfile -t mementos-antigravity-cli-test . && docker run --rm mementos-antigravity-cli-test
scripts.test:docker:opencode: docker build -f tests/docker/integration-test.Dockerfile --build-arg TOOL=opencode-ai --build-arg SMOKE=tests/docker/opencode-smoke.ts -t mementos-opencode-test . && docker run --rm mementos-opencode-test
